verdict.rationale: Store Sync ingests merchant product feeds (Google or OpenAI ACP specs) so that "AI agents [can] discover your products" across partner AI platforms, which is a form of agent-facing discovery. However, it covers physical-goods catalogs, is form-gated, and is limited to US/USD. PayPal's Shopping Cart service mediates access rather than exposing a published directory an arbitrary agent can query, and nothing indexes payable services or APIs. Missing for 10: a public, agent-queryable directory or discovery index, coverage of payable services/APIs and digital goods, self-serve and non-US availability, and independent corroboration.
